beats.event: Victorious in battle, Macbeth meets three witches on the heath
Witches prophesy: Thane of Cawdor, then king hereafter
Duncan names Macbeth Thane of Cawdor; first prophecy fulfilled
Lady Macbeth reads the letter; goads him to murder Duncan
Macbeth stabs the sleeping Duncan at Inverness
Duncan's sons flee; Macbeth is crowned king of Scotland
Macbeth hires assassins to kill Banquo and Fleance
Banquo is killed but Fleance escapes into the darkness
Banquo's ghost appears at the royal banquet, terrifying Macbeth
Witches show three apparitions; he feels safe from any man born of woman
Macbeth orders the massacre of Macduff's wife and children
Macduff joins Malcolm; English army marches on Scotland
Lady Macbeth, mad with guilt, sleepwalks and then dies
Birnam Wood advances on Dunsinane; branches conceal Malcolm's army
Macduff reveals he was not of woman born; kills Macbeth in combat
Malcolm proclaimed king; Macbeth's severed head brought before him
